=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml:38-42 | severity=unspecified | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `promote-candidate` workflow ref regex is fragile because the shell `[[ ... =~ ... ]]` needs an exact match on the workflow file path.
  WHY: A small whitespace difference in the workflow_ref string could make the logic silently fall back to the default behavior. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this: the issue asks for an exact anchored match, and workflow_ref is trusted GitHub job context.
- .github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml:43 | severity=unspecified | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The branch API fetch has no rate-limit handling.
  WHY: If gh_api_retry fails, promote_candidate_json is empty or malformed and the script goes on with an empty SHA. It then logs `SUPPORT_REF source=promote_candidate_unprotected`, which wrongly suggests the branch status was checked. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this: `gh_api_retry` already handles rate limits, and keeping the old source on a failed read is the designed fail-open path.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:128 | severity=unspecified | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The jq parsing of workflow_ref is fragile.
  WHY: Using jq with set -e and `|| true` on possibly malformed input may not handle errors cleanly, which could give unpredictable SCRIPT_REF values. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rejected this: `|| true` returns an empty string, which keeps `github.sha`.
- agents.md:`## Stable log prefixes (contractual)` SUPPORT_REF registry entry | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The PR adds a second, undocumented output shape for the contractual `SUPPORT_REF` log prefix (`source=promote_candidate sha=<sha>` / `source=promote_candidate_unprotected`) in 13 workflows, but ships no `agents.d/<pr>-*.md` fragment updating the registry line.
  WHY: Log-analysis and drift tooling parse `SUPPORT_REF` lines against the documented `ref=<40-hex pin|stable> workflow_ref=<ref|unknown>` shape, so the contract and the runtime output drift apart. The reviewer rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
